Vanessa — we can approve sharing the report once NDA is countersigned. A few compliance notes for the thread:

- We will provide the SOC 2 Type II report PDF + a short bridge letter addressing the audit period and scope.
- For third-party auditor contact details, we provide a redacted point-of-contact (auditor firm general inbox) unless the customer signs an evidence-access addendum.
